book_closures.csv — dividend book-closure / ex-div calendar

Columns:
  stock_code          NSE ticker
  announce_date       When the corporate action was knowable (leakage cut)
  book_closure_date   Book closure date
  ex_date             Ex-dividend date (optional)

Features (features/build.py):
  near_book_closure       1 if announce_date ≤ trade_date ≤ book_closure_date
  days_since_book_closure days since last closure (NaN before first event)

Replace sample rows with official NSE announcements for production use.
